responsibility: Implements the Cygwin-specific D front-end target hooks layered on top of the i386 backend. It registers the D predefined version identifiers for the Cygwin/Windows/Posix runtime environment, answers D target-info queries such as objectFormat with the COFF value, and sets the D hook indicating that templates are always emitted into COMDAT, making this file the D-language OS adaptation companion to the generic x86 D support.
